title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.19636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. translated_title: 稀疏自编码器是符号匹配的共享坐标系
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在一组权重中蕴含了广泛的知识，但缺乏可解释性和可信赖的推理能力，尤其是在高风险的应用场景中。神经符号模型凭借其可解释的架构和系统2（System 2）推理能力，如果能构建到LLM的规模，将是一种有前景的替代方案；然而，其符号骨干通常需要人工构建，因此现有的神经符号模型受限于符号组件的覆盖范围，通常只能应用于特定领域。一种数据驱动的方法则可以通过对齐和合并现有的符号系统来构建更大的符号系统。我们瞄准了这一方向的第一步基础性工作：在这些异构系统之间进行单元匹配。我们的方法SAE-IDF使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将符号在其原生语境中编码为稀疏代码，根据每个维度的稀有度进行重新加权，并在不同系统之间进行匹配。在涵盖6种符号系统的12个任务上，SAE-IDF的表现优于基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出SAE-IDF方法，利用稀疏自编码器将符号编码为稀疏表示并根据稀有度重新加权，实现了跨异构符号系统的单元匹配，为通过数据驱动方式对齐与合并现有符号系统、构建大规模神经符号模型迈出了关键的第一步。
en_tdlr: SAE-IDF uses sparse autoencoders to encode symbols in their native context into sparse codes re-weighted by rarity, enabling unit matching across heterogeneous symbolic systems and providing the foundational step toward data-driven alignment and merging of symbolic systems at LLM scale.
